QROOT.text: Исследуйте устройство образца S17 и его окружение. Сохраняйте найденные объекты, связи, основания и открытые вопросы. Различайте наблюдения, сообщения источников и гипотезы. Порядок, число объектов и глубина разбиения не заданы.

Q1.text: What documents, calibrations or material descriptions does catalog:root expose, and under what revision identifiers?

Q2.text: What structure does doc:model-M7@1 attribute to model M7, and does it name parts, materials or ports compatible with sample S17?

Q3.text: Does the outer surface or coating actually present on sample S17 correspond to the P-A claim made for model M7, or is the sample's outer material different?

Q4.text: What radial internal structure (interfaces, layer radii) does S17 show in state-0 at 20 C along its axis, and does any resolved outer interval correspond to the P-A coating claim for model M7 or to a different outer material?

Q5.text: Which material designations and contrast responses does doc:references@1 list, and do any of them match the contrast values of the S17 zones (100 at inner, 160 at middle, 230 at outer), in particular a P-A reference response?

Q6.text: Is the radial contrast zone structure at x_mm=500 the same as at x_mm=0 in state-0, i.e. are the zones axially uniform along S17?

Q7.text: What five-channel material_response does S17 return at x_mm=0, radius 90 um (outer zone) in state-0, and does it match any doc:references@1 entry given that P-A and P-B are indistinguishable there?

Q8.text: What material_response does the contacting medium U09 return at 20 C, and could the medium rather than S17 contribute to any radial contrast interval?

Q9.text: What material_response do the inner (r=2 um) and middle (r=20 um) zones of S17 return at 20 C, and do they differ from the outer zone, establishing that the outer zone is a distinct coating layer rather than the bulk?

Q10.text: Is the inner-zone response difference from the glass reference (0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052 vs 0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05) within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1, or does it indicate a distinct core material?

Q11.text: Does the small difference between the inner-zone vector [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052] and the middle-zone glass-equal vector [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] indicate a real core/interface at r about 4 um, or is it within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1?

Q12.text: Given that S17 material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0, can the axial persistence of the outer P-A/P-B-like interval be established from radial_profile at x_mm=500, or does the access contract limit which axial conclusions are possible?

Q13.text: Are the contrast zones uniform over the whole 1000 mm length of S17, or only between the two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500, given that material_response cannot be obtained away from x_mm=0?

Q14.text: What input and output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, and do any delay or secondary output events add structural information (paths, ports, internal reflections) beyond the radial zones?

Q15.text: Does raising the cell to 40 C (state-1) change the pulse_trace of S17 or of the surroundings, i.e. is any part of the observed structure or its medium temperature-dependent?

Q16.text: Does the U09 deviation from the water reference beyond 0.001 per channel indicate a water-based medium carrying an additional component, and can the doc:calibration@1 additive mixing assumption resolve the composition from the observed five-channel vector alone?

Q17.text: Can the P-A outer-coating claim of doc:model-M7@1 be transferred to S17 at all, given that S17 is immersed in the water-like medium U09 rather than the dry air named in the document's described operating example?

Q18.text: Does the constant 5.0 ns input-to-output delay of S17 change at 40 C (state-1) or after return to 20 C (state-2), i.e. is the pulse transit path temperature-dependent while the sample identity is preserved?

Q19.text: Do the pulse_trace ports S17:in and S17:out lie on the probed sample axis, and does the single output event per input exclude detectable partial reflections from the radial interfaces at r about 4 um and about 62.5 um?

history.question: Read catalog:root to enumerate the available documents, calibrations and material references, and note the revision returned.

statements.claim: В типовом исполнении внешнее покрытие изготовлено из P-A.
В описанном примере эксплуатации изделие находится в сухом воздухе.

payload.scope_note: Номер S17 и его фактические условия в документе не указаны.

history.question: Read doc:model-M7@1 to see the claimed structure of model M7 and whether it matches sample S17.

payload.annotation_method: Вручную заданное описание кадра; распознавание изображений этой фикстурой не проверяется.

visible_objects.description: Прозрачная ячейка вокруг участка S17.
Прозрачное содержимое ячейки, соприкасающееся с S17.

measured_outline.scope: Внешняя граница S17 в обзорном кадре; меньшие радиальные неоднородности здесь не разрешены.

history.question: Observe S17 with the overview method in state-0 (20 C) to collect its actual gross structure and outer surface, so the P-A coating claim from doc:model-M7@1 can be compared against the specimen rather than assumed.

payload.field_note: Неразрушающий радиальный профиль на одном заданном сечении; осевая симметрия и непрерывность между сечениями не измерялись.

history.question: Observe S17 with radial_profile at x_mm=0 in state-0 (20 C) to resolve the radial internal structure and interfaces, so the outer-material question in Q3 can be tested against actual layers rather than assumed from the M7 document.

payload.scope: Это открытый набор эталонов, а не список всех возможных материалов мира.

history.question: Read doc:references@1 to obtain the reference material response signatures (including any for P-A), so the contrast values of the S17 zones can be compared against references rather than assumed from the M7 class document.

Observe S17 with material_response at x_mm=0 and radius 90 um in state-0 (20 C) to obtain the actual channel signature of the outer zone, so it can be compared against the doc:references@1 entries rather than assumed from the M7 class document.

Observe S17 with material_response at x_mm=0 and radius 2 um in state-0 (20 C) to obtain the inner-zone channel signature, so the outer P-A/P-B-like zone and the middle zone can be shown to be distinct layers rather than the same bulk material.
Observe material_response of S17 at x_mm=0, radius 20 um in state-0 (20 C) to obtain the middle-zone signature, completing the inner/middle/outer zone comparison required by Q9.

response.meaning: No available response for this request and context; not a physical impossibility.

history.question: Observe S17 material_response at x_mm=500, radius 90 um in state-0 to test whether the P-A-like outer interval persists along the axis, which the outer-material identification of S17 (Q3) depends on.

payload.field_note: Неразрушающий радиальный профиль на одном заданном сечении; осевая симметрия и непрерывность между сечениями не измерялись.

history.question: Observe S17 radial_profile at x_mm=500 in state-0 (20 C) to test whether the three contrast intervals (100/160/230) persist along the axis, since material_response is unavailable there and only radial_profile can address axial uniformity.

radial_profile.statement: Измерения относятся только к выбранным координатам; граница локализуется между соседними отсчётами.

material_response.mixing_assumption: В этом учебном приборе отклик смеси равен сумме откликов компонентов с массовыми долями; это условие макета, не закон реальной спектроскопии.
material_response.statement: Совпадение откликов не устанавливает единственность состава. Пространственное распределение добавки внутри измеряемого пятна не различается.

pulse_trace.statement: Записываются только вход и выход; путь импульса внутри образца не наблюдается.

history.question: Read doc:calibration@1 to obtain the instrument tolerance and stated measurement limits, so the exact match of the S17 outer-zone vector to the P-A (and P-B) reference can be judged as inside or outside tolerance for Q3.

Observe the contacting medium U09 with material_response at 20 C in state-0 to obtain its five-channel signature, so we can test whether the medium itself could contribute to the radial contrast intervals or the outer-zone reading (Q8).

Q3 requires separating P-A from P-B for S17's outer interval; the 20 C five-channel evidence cannot do that and the medium question is now answered. What time-of-flight/port structure does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, so any additional structural constraint on the outer region and its access points (and the still-open Q14) can be recorded before the evidence budget closes?

With pulse_trace for S17 in state-0 now recorded (constant 5.0 ns delay, one output per input, ports S17:in and S17:out), set the cell V04 to 40 C to enter state-1, so the temperature dependence of the pulse transit can be tested before the evidence budget closes.

Q3 still asks whether S17's outer interval is the model-M7 P-A coating; the 20 C five-channel evidence cannot separate P-A from P-B and material_response is unavailable at 40 C, so the remaining structural handle is whether the sample's transit path is invariant. What input/output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in the newly entered state-1 (40 C), so the temperature dependence of the 5.0 ns delay can be compared with state-0 and a temperature-invariant transit constraint on the sample can be added alongside the open outer-material question?

events.message: Document or error alone is not a physical observation; use source_report for document contents or metadata

assertions.scope: Two radial_profile sections only, x_mm=0 and x_mm=500; no interpolation between them.
assertions.statement: radial_profile at x_mm=500 in state-0 returns the same contrast sequence 100/160/230 at the same r_um boundaries as at x_mm=0, so the zone pattern is reproducible at these two sections.

assertions.scope: Access contract of the fixture, not a material property.
assertions.statement: material_response for S17 is tabulated only at x_mm=0; the x_mm=500 request returned fixture_not_specified, an access failure rather than a physical result.

assertions.scope: Only for the single 20 C five-channel signature at x_mm=0, r=90 um.
assertions.statement: The outer-zone signature [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2] equals both the P-A and P-B reference vectors, so those designations cannot be separated for this zone from this measurement alone.

question_updates.reason: x_mm=500 profile equals the x_mm=0 contrast pattern, so the two probed sections show the same zone structure.
material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0 and the x_mm=500 request failed as an access limit, so material-based axial conclusions cannot come from that method.
The outer-zone signature matches both P-A and P-B in the open reference set, so P-A identification of the outer material stays unresolved.

questions.text: Are the contrast zones uniform over the whole 1000 mm length of S17, or only between the two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500, given that material_response cannot be obtained away from x_mm=0?

rejected_candidate.question: Read doc:calibration@1 to obtain the instrument tolerance and stated limits, so the exact match of the S17 outer-zone vector to the P-A (and P-B) reference can be judged inside or outside measurement tolerance for Q3.
rejected_candidate.summary: Newest data: C0010 radial_profile at x_mm=500 reproduces the x_mm=0 contrast pattern (100/160/230 at identical radii), supporting axial persistence of the zones at the two probed sections; C0009 shows material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0, an access limit not physics. Q6 and Q12 closed; Q3 stays open because P-A and P-B share the outer-zone signature. Next: read the calibration document for tolerances.

events.message: OpenRouter response token limit

assertions.scope: Single pulse_trace in state-1 (40 C), same ports and input schedule as state-0; one output event per input.
assertions.statement: pulse_trace of S17 in state-1 returns outputs at 5.01, 105.01 and 205.01 ns for inputs at 0, 100 and 200 ns, a constant 5.01 ns offset that is 0.01 ns longer than the 5.0 ns offset in state-0.

assertions.scope: One intervention record A01; identity of S17, V04 and U09 declared preserved.
assertions.statement: set_temperature on V04 to 40 C moved the fixture from state-0 to state-1 with S17, V04 and U09 identity preserved and other instrument settings unchanged.

question_updates.reason: The pulse_trace offset changed from 5.0 ns to 5.01 ns at 40 C, so the pulse transit is temperature dependent.
state-1 offset is 5.01 ns versus 5.0 ns at 20 C, but the state-2 return to 20 C has not been measured yet.

questions.text: After returning V04 to 20 C (state-2), does the pulse_trace offset of S17 return to 5.0 ns (reversible) or stay near 5.01 ns (hysteretic), and do the input/output port names remain S17:in and S17:out?

response.question: Return the cell V04 to 20 C to enter state-2, so pulse_trace can be re-measured at 20 C and the 5.0 ns / 5.01 ns difference between state-0 and state-1 can be tested for reversibility while S17 identity is preserved.
response.summary: Newest data C0015: pulse_trace of S17 in state-1 (40 C) shows a constant 5.01 ns input-to-output offset (5.01/105.01/205.01 ns), 0.01 ns longer than the 5.0 ns offset in state-0, with one output per input. C0014/A01 already recorded the state-0 to state-1 transition at 40 C preserving S17, V04 and U09. Q15 is answered (transit is temperature dependent); Q18 stays open because the return to 20 C (state-2) has not been probed. Next: set V04 back to 20 C.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Прочитать ресурс по уже известной ссылке. Ответ содержит ревизию источника.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Получить данные доступного прибора. Координаты задаются относительно образца; части и их названия не являются параметрами.

tools.name: pulse_trace
tools.description: Ввести оптические импульсы во входной порт и записать время входа и выхода с общими часами.

tools.description: Задать температуру доступной ячейки. Меняет состояние; идентичность образца сохраняется.

start.repeat_semantics: Повтор в том же состоянии и ревизии источника возвращает ту же запись. Изменение состояния или ревизии источника требует новой записи. Эти данные детерминированы и не задают статистику независимых шумовых повторов.
start.undefined_requests: fixture_not_specified означает пробел таблицы, а не физическую невозможность. Каждый вызов, включая ошибку, получает call_id.

access_contract.read: Только известные catalog:*, doc:* и material:*; чтение доступно во всех состояниях. Другие ссылки обозначают объекты/порты, а не читаемые документы.
access_contract.observe_note: Все методы observe доступны только при 20 C. state-2 — новый эпизод после возврата к 20 C; ответы для него заданы отдельно.
access_contract.unknown_target: Сначала получить ссылку из доступного источника.
access_contract.errors: unknown_resource / capability_not_available / state_not_available — ограничения контракта. Они не являются измерениями вещества.

start.evidence_protocol: START — начальный публичный ввод; C0001 и т.д. — все попытки действий; record_id — исходная запись источника. Повтор получает новый call_id, но не новое независимое измерение. Смена состояния не создаёт новый образец.

Q7.text: What five-channel material_response does S17 return at x_mm=0, radius 90 um (outer zone) in state-0, and does it match any doc:references@1 entry given that P-A and P-B are indistinguishable there?

Q8.text: What material_response does the contacting medium U09 return at 20 C, and could the medium rather than S17 contribute to any radial contrast interval?

Q9.text: What material_response do the inner (r=2 um) and middle (r=20 um) zones of S17 return at 20 C, and do they differ from the outer zone, establishing that the outer zone is a distinct coating layer rather than the bulk?

Q10.text: Is the inner-zone response difference from the glass reference (0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052 vs 0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05) within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1, or does it indicate a distinct core material?

Q11.text: Does the small difference between the inner-zone vector [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052] and the middle-zone glass-equal vector [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] indicate a real core/interface at r about 4 um, or is it within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1?

Q12.text: Given that S17 material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0, can the axial persistence of the outer P-A/P-B-like interval be established from radial_profile at x_mm=500, or does the access contract limit which axial conclusions are possible?

Q13.text: Are the contrast zones uniform over the whole 1000 mm length of S17, or only between the two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500, given that material_response cannot be obtained away from x_mm=0?

Q14.text: What input and output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, and do any delay or secondary output events add structural information (paths, ports, internal reflections) beyond the radial zones?

Q15.text: Does raising the cell to 40 C (state-1) change the pulse_trace of S17 or of the surroundings, i.e. is any part of the observed structure or its medium temperature-dependent?

Q16.text: Does the U09 deviation from the water reference beyond 0.001 per channel indicate a water-based medium carrying an additional component, and can the doc:calibration@1 additive mixing assumption resolve the composition from the observed five-channel vector alone?

Q17.text: Can the P-A outer-coating claim of doc:model-M7@1 be transferred to S17 at all, given that S17 is immersed in the water-like medium U09 rather than the dry air named in the document's described operating example?

Q18.text: Does the constant 5.0 ns input-to-output delay of S17 change at 40 C (state-1) or after return to 20 C (state-2), i.e. is the pulse transit path temperature-dependent while the sample identity is preserved?

Q19.text: Do the pulse_trace ports S17:in and S17:out lie on the probed sample axis, and does the single output event per input exclude detectable partial reflections from the radial interfaces at r about 4 um and about 62.5 um?

Q20.text: After returning V04 to 20 C (state-2), does the pulse_trace offset of S17 return to 5.0 ns (reversible) or stay near 5.01 ns (hysteretic), and do the input/output port names remain S17:in and S17:out?

start.repeat_semantics: Повтор в том же состоянии и ревизии источника возвращает ту же запись. Изменение состояния или ревизии источника требует новой записи. Эти данные детерминированы и не задают статистику независимых шумовых повторов.

access_contract.read: Только известные catalog:*, doc:* и material:*; чтение доступно во всех состояниях. Другие ссылки обозначают объекты/порты, а не читаемые документы.

access_contract.errors: unknown_resource / capability_not_available / state_not_available — ограничения контракта. Они не являются измерениями вещества.

start.evidence_protocol: START — начальный публичный ввод; C0001 и т.д. — все попытки действий; record_id — исходная запись источника. Повтор получает новый call_id, но не новое независимое измерение. Смена состояния не создаёт новый образец.

payload.scope: Это открытый набор эталонов, а не список всех возможных материалов мира.

history.question: Read doc:references@1 to obtain the reference material response signatures (including any for P-A), so the contrast values of the S17 zones can be compared against references rather than assumed from the M7 class document.

Observe S17 with material_response at x_mm=0 and radius 90 um in state-0 (20 C) to obtain the actual channel signature of the outer zone, so it can be compared against the doc:references@1 entries rather than assumed from the M7 class document.

Observe S17 with material_response at x_mm=0 and radius 2 um in state-0 (20 C) to obtain the inner-zone channel signature, so the outer P-A/P-B-like zone and the middle zone can be shown to be distinct layers rather than the same bulk material.
Observe material_response of S17 at x_mm=0, radius 20 um in state-0 (20 C) to obtain the middle-zone signature, completing the inner/middle/outer zone comparison required by Q9.

response.meaning: No available response for this request and context; not a physical impossibility.

history.question: Observe S17 material_response at x_mm=500, radius 90 um in state-0 to test whether the P-A-like outer interval persists along the axis, which the outer-material identification of S17 (Q3) depends on.

payload.field_note: Неразрушающий радиальный профиль на одном заданном сечении; осевая симметрия и непрерывность между сечениями не измерялись.

history.question: Observe S17 radial_profile at x_mm=500 in state-0 (20 C) to test whether the three contrast intervals (100/160/230) persist along the axis, since material_response is unavailable there and only radial_profile can address axial uniformity.

radial_profile.statement: Измерения относятся только к выбранным координатам; граница локализуется между соседними отсчётами.

material_response.mixing_assumption: В этом учебном приборе отклик смеси равен сумме откликов компонентов с массовыми долями; это условие макета, не закон реальной спектроскопии.
material_response.statement: Совпадение откликов не устанавливает единственность состава. Пространственное распределение добавки внутри измеряемого пятна не различается.

pulse_trace.statement: Записываются только вход и выход; путь импульса внутри образца не наблюдается.

history.question: Read doc:calibration@1 to obtain the instrument tolerance and stated measurement limits, so the exact match of the S17 outer-zone vector to the P-A (and P-B) reference can be judged as inside or outside tolerance for Q3.

Observe the contacting medium U09 with material_response at 20 C in state-0 to obtain its five-channel signature, so we can test whether the medium itself could contribute to the radial contrast intervals or the outer-zone reading (Q8).

Q3 requires separating P-A from P-B for S17's outer interval; the 20 C five-channel evidence cannot do that and the medium question is now answered. What time-of-flight/port structure does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, so any additional structural constraint on the outer region and its access points (and the still-open Q14) can be recorded before the evidence budget closes?

With pulse_trace for S17 in state-0 now recorded (constant 5.0 ns delay, one output per input, ports S17:in and S17:out), set the cell V04 to 40 C to enter state-1, so the temperature dependence of the pulse transit can be tested before the evidence budget closes.

Q3 still asks whether S17's outer interval is the model-M7 P-A coating; the 20 C five-channel evidence cannot separate P-A from P-B and material_response is unavailable at 40 C, so the remaining structural handle is whether the sample's transit path is invariant. What input/output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in the newly entered state-1 (40 C), so the temperature dependence of the 5.0 ns delay can be compared with state-0 and a temperature-invariant transit constraint on the sample can be added alongside the open outer-material question?

Return the cell V04 to 20 C to enter state-2, so pulse_trace can be re-measured at 20 C and the 5.0 ns / 5.01 ns difference between state-0 and state-1 can be tested for reversibility while S17 identity is preserved.

State-2 (20 C) is now the current episode and pulse_trace is available there; re-measure S17's pulse_trace to test whether the 5.0 ns to 5.01 ns transit offset seen between state-0 and state-1 reverses or persists, addressing Q18 and Q20 while identity is preserved.

events.message: Document or error alone is not a physical observation; use source_report for document contents or metadata

assertions.scope: Two radial_profile sections only, x_mm=0 and x_mm=500; no interpolation between them.
assertions.statement: radial_profile at x_mm=500 in state-0 returns the same contrast sequence 100/160/230 at the same r_um boundaries as at x_mm=0, so the zone pattern is reproducible at these two sections.

assertions.scope: Access contract of the fixture, not a material property.
assertions.statement: material_response for S17 is tabulated only at x_mm=0; the x_mm=500 request returned fixture_not_specified, an access failure rather than a physical result.

assertions.scope: Only for the single 20 C five-channel signature at x_mm=0, r=90 um.
assertions.statement: The outer-zone signature [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2] equals both the P-A and P-B reference vectors, so those designations cannot be separated for this zone from this measurement alone.

question_updates.reason: x_mm=500 profile equals the x_mm=0 contrast pattern, so the two probed sections show the same zone structure.
material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0 and the x_mm=500 request failed as an access limit, so material-based axial conclusions cannot come from that method.
The outer-zone signature matches both P-A and P-B in the open reference set, so P-A identification of the outer material stays unresolved.

questions.text: Are the contrast zones uniform over the whole 1000 mm length of S17, or only between the two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500, given that material_response cannot be obtained away from x_mm=0?

rejected_candidate.question: Read doc:calibration@1 to obtain the instrument tolerance and stated limits, so the exact match of the S17 outer-zone vector to the P-A (and P-B) reference can be judged inside or outside measurement tolerance for Q3.
rejected_candidate.summary: Newest data: C0010 radial_profile at x_mm=500 reproduces the x_mm=0 contrast pattern (100/160/230 at identical radii), supporting axial persistence of the zones at the two probed sections; C0009 shows material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0, an access limit not physics. Q6 and Q12 closed; Q3 stays open because P-A and P-B share the outer-zone signature. Next: read the calibration document for tolerances.

events.message: OpenRouter response token limit

assertions.scope: One pulse_trace episode in state-2 (20 C), three input events; only input and output recorded.
assertions.statement: In state-2 pulse_trace reports output times 5.0, 105.0 and 205.0 ns for inputs 0, 100 and 200 ns via S17:in and S17:out, i.e. a constant 5.0 ns offset with one output per input.

assertions.scope: Comparison across the three recorded episodes only; no independent repeats and no path geometry observed.
assertions.statement: The transit offset is 5.0 ns at 20 C (state-0 and state-2) and 5.01 ns at 40 C (state-1), so the 0.01 ns shift seen on heating was not reproduced after returning to 20 C and the sample identity was preserved throughout.

question_updates.reason: Delay is 5.0 ns at 20 C in both state-0 and state-2 versus 5.01 ns at 40 C, so the offset is temperature-linked and returns to its 20 C value.
After return to 20 C the offset is again 5.0 ns and the port names remain S17:in and S17:out, so the change reverses at the 0.001 ns resolution.

The outer-zone vector equals both P-A and P-B, material_response is available only at 20 C, and doc:calibration@1 declares the reference library incomplete, so no accessible measurement separates the two designations for S17.

pulse_trace reports only port names and in/out times with no geometry and only one output event per input, so port axis position and absence of partial reflections cannot be tested with the accessible methods.

questions.text: Given that P-A and P-B share one five-channel vector and doc:calibration@1 calls the reference library incomplete, could any accessible intervention (e.g. a temperature series of material_response, or an added reference entry) separate the outer-zone designation, or is the outer material identifiability bounded by the open reference set alone?

response.question: Oldest open question remains Q3 (outer-material identity of S17), now blocked because P-A and P-B share one reference vector and the reference library is declared incomplete; the newest state-2 pulse_trace closes Q18 and Q20. No accessible measurement can further separate the outer-material designations, so the investigation is consolidated.
response.summary: Newest data C0017/O10: after returning V04 to 20 C, S17 pulse_trace again shows a constant 5.0 ns offset (5.0/105.0/205.0 ns) with ports S17:in and S17:out, matching state-0 and differing from the 5.01 ns seen at 40 C, so the temperature-linked shift is reversible. Q18 and Q20 are answered; Q3 stays unresolved and is recorded as blocked (P-A and P-B share the outer-zone vector, reference library incomplete); Q19 is blocked by the absence of port geometry. A new question Q21 asks whether any accessible measurement could separate the outer-zone designation. Edge budget spent; consolidating with finish.

start.repeat_semantics: Повтор в том же состоянии и ревизии источника возвращает ту же запись. Изменение состояния или ревизии источника требует новой записи. Эти данные детерминированы и не задают статистику независимых шумовых повторов.
start.undefined_requests: fixture_not_specified означает пробел таблицы, а не физическую невозможность. Каждый вызов, включая ошибку, получает call_id.

access_contract.read: Только известные catalog:*, doc:* и material:*; чтение доступно во всех состояниях. Другие ссылки обозначают объекты/порты, а не читаемые документы.
access_contract.observe_note: Все методы observe доступны только при 20 C. state-2 — новый эпизод после возврата к 20 C; ответы для него заданы отдельно.
access_contract.unknown_target: Сначала получить ссылку из доступного источника.
access_contract.errors: unknown_resource / capability_not_available / state_not_available — ограничения контракта. Они не являются измерениями вещества.

start.evidence_protocol: START — начальный публичный ввод; C0001 и т.д. — все попытки действий; record_id — исходная запись источника. Повтор получает новый call_id, но не новое независимое измерение. Смена состояния не создаёт новый образец.

referenced_by_catalog.description: An entity is listed or exposed through a catalog/document resource.

has_part.description: An entity is a constituent part or component of another entity.

described_in.description: An entity is the subject of a source document's claims.

specifies_material.description: A source document attributes a material to a described model or item.

specifies_environment.description: A source document attributes an environmental or operating condition to a described model or item.

scope_excludes_subject.description: A source's declared scope explicitly does not include a given subject, so its claims do not transfer by identity.

surrounds.description: An entity physically encloses or spans around another entity as its immediate surroundings.

contacts.description: An entity is in touching physical contact with another entity.

has_measured_dimension.description: An entity has a dimension or outline interval reported by an observation or source.

has_radial_zone.description: An entity exhibits a contrast-delimited radial interval resolved at a specified axial section.

reports_reference_response.description: A source document reports a measured response or signature vector for a named reference material.

indistinguishable_in.description: Two designations cannot be separated by the evidence of a stated source or data set.

requires_measurement.description: Identification of an entity is not resolvable with current evidence and depends on a specific additional measurement.

response_equals.description: An observed response vector of an entity is identical to a reference response vector reported for a named material.

response_resembles.description: An observed response vector is close to but not identical to a reference vector for a named material.

distinct_from.description: Two entities are shown to be separate by measurably different observed responses.

access_limited_to.description: An entity's accessible measurement method is tabulated only for a stated parameter range, so requests outside it return an access failure rather than a physical result.

states_tolerance_for.description: A source document states a measurement tolerance, resolution or validity limit that applies to observations of a given subject.

has_port.description: An entity exposes a named accessible port reported by an instrument record.

has_signal_transit_delay.description: A pulse_trace record shows a fixed offset between input and output event times for an entity.

records_state_transition.description: An intervention record documents that heating or actuating an entity moved the fixture from one state to another while preserving stated identities.

QROOT.text: Исследуйте устройство образца S17 и его окружение. Сохраняйте найденные объекты, связи, основания и открытые вопросы. Различайте наблюдения, сообщения источников и гипотезы. Порядок, число объектов и глубина разбиения не заданы.

Q1.text: What documents, calibrations or material descriptions does catalog:root expose, and under what revision identifiers?

Q2.text: What structure does doc:model-M7@1 attribute to model M7, and does it name parts, materials or ports compatible with sample S17?

Q3.text: Does the outer surface or coating actually present on sample S17 correspond to the P-A claim made for model M7, or is the sample's outer material different?

Q4.text: What radial internal structure (interfaces, layer radii) does S17 show in state-0 at 20 C along its axis, and does any resolved outer interval correspond to the P-A coating claim for model M7 or to a different outer material?

Q5.text: Which material designations and contrast responses does doc:references@1 list, and do any of them match the contrast values of the S17 zones (100 at inner, 160 at middle, 230 at outer), in particular a P-A reference response?

Q6.text: Is the radial contrast zone structure at x_mm=500 the same as at x_mm=0 in state-0, i.e. are the zones axially uniform along S17?

Q7.text: What five-channel material_response does S17 return at x_mm=0, radius 90 um (outer zone) in state-0, and does it match any doc:references@1 entry given that P-A and P-B are indistinguishable there?

Q8.text: What material_response does the contacting medium U09 return at 20 C, and could the medium rather than S17 contribute to any radial contrast interval?

Q9.text: What material_response do the inner (r=2 um) and middle (r=20 um) zones of S17 return at 20 C, and do they differ from the outer zone, establishing that the outer zone is a distinct coating layer rather than the bulk?

Q10.text: Is the inner-zone response difference from the glass reference (0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052 vs 0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05) within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1, or does it indicate a distinct core material?

Q11.text: Does the small difference between the inner-zone vector [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052] and the middle-zone glass-equal vector [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] indicate a real core/interface at r about 4 um, or is it within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1?

Q12.text: Given that S17 material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0, can the axial persistence of the outer P-A/P-B-like interval be established from radial_profile at x_mm=500, or does the access contract limit which axial conclusions are possible?

Q13.text: Are the contrast zones uniform over the whole 1000 mm length of S17, or only between the two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500, given that material_response cannot be obtained away from x_mm=0?

Q14.text: What input and output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, and do any delay or secondary output events add structural information (paths, ports, internal reflections) beyond the radial zones?

Q15.text: Does raising the cell to 40 C (state-1) change the pulse_trace of S17 or of the surroundings, i.e. is any part of the observed structure or its medium temperature-dependent?

Q16.text: Does the U09 deviation from the water reference beyond 0.001 per channel indicate a water-based medium carrying an additional component, and can the doc:calibration@1 additive mixing assumption resolve the composition from the observed five-channel vector alone?

Q17.text: Can the P-A outer-coating claim of doc:model-M7@1 be transferred to S17 at all, given that S17 is immersed in the water-like medium U09 rather than the dry air named in the document's described operating example?

Q18.text: Does the constant 5.0 ns input-to-output delay of S17 change at 40 C (state-1) or after return to 20 C (state-2), i.e. is the pulse transit path temperature-dependent while the sample identity is preserved?

Q19.text: Do the pulse_trace ports S17:in and S17:out lie on the probed sample axis, and does the single output event per input exclude detectable partial reflections from the radial interfaces at r about 4 um and about 62.5 um?

Q20.text: After returning V04 to 20 C (state-2), does the pulse_trace offset of S17 return to 5.0 ns (reversible) or stay near 5.01 ns (hysteretic), and do the input/output port names remain S17:in and S17:out?

Q21.text: Given that P-A and P-B share one five-channel vector and doc:calibration@1 calls the reference library incomplete, could any accessible intervention (e.g. a temperature series of material_response, or an added reference entry) separate the outer-zone designation, or is the outer material identifiability bounded by the open reference set alone?

QROOT.text: Исследуйте устройство образца S17 и его окружение. Сохраняйте найденные объекты, связи, основания и открытые вопросы. Различайте наблюдения, сообщения источников и гипотезы. Порядок, число объектов и глубина разбиения не заданы.

Q1.text: What documents, calibrations or material descriptions does catalog:root expose, and under what revision identifiers?

Q2.text: What structure does doc:model-M7@1 attribute to model M7, and does it name parts, materials or ports compatible with sample S17?

Q3.text: Does the outer surface or coating actually present on sample S17 correspond to the P-A claim made for model M7, or is the sample's outer material different?

Q4.text: What radial internal structure (interfaces, layer radii) does S17 show in state-0 at 20 C along its axis, and does any resolved outer interval correspond to the P-A coating claim for model M7 or to a different outer material?

Q5.text: Which material designations and contrast responses does doc:references@1 list, and do any of them match the contrast values of the S17 zones (100 at inner, 160 at middle, 230 at outer), in particular a P-A reference response?

Q6.text: Is the radial contrast zone structure at x_mm=500 the same as at x_mm=0 in state-0, i.e. are the zones axially uniform along S17?

Q7.text: What five-channel material_response does S17 return at x_mm=0, radius 90 um (outer zone) in state-0, and does it match any doc:references@1 entry given that P-A and P-B are indistinguishable there?

Q8.text: What material_response does the contacting medium U09 return at 20 C, and could the medium rather than S17 contribute to any radial contrast interval?

Q9.text: What material_response do the inner (r=2 um) and middle (r=20 um) zones of S17 return at 20 C, and do they differ from the outer zone, establishing that the outer zone is a distinct coating layer rather than the bulk?

Q10.text: Is the inner-zone response difference from the glass reference (0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052 vs 0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05) within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1, or does it indicate a distinct core material?

Q11.text: Does the small difference between the inner-zone vector [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052] and the middle-zone glass-equal vector [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] indicate a real core/interface at r about 4 um, or is it within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1?

Q12.text: Given that S17 material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0, can the axial persistence of the outer P-A/P-B-like interval be established from radial_profile at x_mm=500, or does the access contract limit which axial conclusions are possible?

Q13.text: Are the contrast zones uniform over the whole 1000 mm length of S17, or only between the two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500, given that material_response cannot be obtained away from x_mm=0?

Q14.text: What input and output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, and do any delay or secondary output events add structural information (paths, ports, internal reflections) beyond the radial zones?

Q15.text: Does raising the cell to 40 C (state-1) change the pulse_trace of S17 or of the surroundings, i.e. is any part of the observed structure or its medium temperature-dependent?

Q16.text: Does the U09 deviation from the water reference beyond 0.001 per channel indicate a water-based medium carrying an additional component, and can the doc:calibration@1 additive mixing assumption resolve the composition from the observed five-channel vector alone?

Q17.text: Can the P-A outer-coating claim of doc:model-M7@1 be transferred to S17 at all, given that S17 is immersed in the water-like medium U09 rather than the dry air named in the document's described operating example?

Q18.text: Does the constant 5.0 ns input-to-output delay of S17 change at 40 C (state-1) or after return to 20 C (state-2), i.e. is the pulse transit path temperature-dependent while the sample identity is preserved?

Q19.text: Do the pulse_trace ports S17:in and S17:out lie on the probed sample axis, and does the single output event per input exclude detectable partial reflections from the radial interfaces at r about 4 um and about 62.5 um?

Q20.text: After returning V04 to 20 C (state-2), does the pulse_trace offset of S17 return to 5.0 ns (reversible) or stay near 5.01 ns (hysteretic), and do the input/output port names remain S17:in and S17:out?

Q21.text: Given that P-A and P-B share one five-channel vector and doc:calibration@1 calls the reference library incomplete, could any accessible intervention (e.g. a temperature series of material_response, or an added reference entry) separate the outer-zone designation, or is the outer material identifiability bounded by the open reference set alone?

Q22.text: Has the new-source window added or revised catalog entries (new documents, an expanded reference set, or an updated M7 description) that could separate the outer-zone material or resolve the axial interior structure?

start.repeat_semantics: Повтор в том же состоянии и ревизии источника возвращает ту же запись. Изменение состояния или ревизии источника требует новой записи. Эти данные детерминированы и не задают статистику независимых шумовых повторов.
start.undefined_requests: fixture_not_specified означает пробел таблицы, а не физическую невозможность. Каждый вызов, включая ошибку, получает call_id.

access_contract.read: Только известные catalog:*, doc:* и material:*; чтение доступно во всех состояниях. Другие ссылки обозначают объекты/порты, а не читаемые документы.
access_contract.observe_note: Все методы observe доступны только при 20 C. state-2 — новый эпизод после возврата к 20 C; ответы для него заданы отдельно.
access_contract.unknown_target: Сначала получить ссылку из доступного источника.
access_contract.errors: unknown_resource / capability_not_available / state_not_available — ограничения контракта. Они не являются измерениями вещества.

start.evidence_protocol: START — начальный публичный ввод; C0001 и т.д. — все попытки действий; record_id — исходная запись источника. Повтор получает новый call_id, но не новое независимое измерение. Смена состояния не создаёт новый образец.

QROOT.text: Исследуйте устройство образца S17 и его окружение. Сохраняйте найденные объекты, связи, основания и открытые вопросы. Различайте наблюдения, сообщения источников и гипотезы. Порядок, число объектов и глубина разбиения не заданы.

Q1.text: What documents, calibrations or material descriptions does catalog:root expose, and under what revision identifiers?

Q2.text: What structure does doc:model-M7@1 attribute to model M7, and does it name parts, materials or ports compatible with sample S17?

Q3.text: Does the outer surface or coating actually present on sample S17 correspond to the P-A claim made for model M7, or is the sample's outer material different?

Q4.text: What radial internal structure (interfaces, layer radii) does S17 show in state-0 at 20 C along its axis, and does any resolved outer interval correspond to the P-A coating claim for model M7 or to a different outer material?

Q5.text: Which material designations and contrast responses does doc:references@1 list, and do any of them match the contrast values of the S17 zones (100 at inner, 160 at middle, 230 at outer), in particular a P-A reference response?

Q6.text: Is the radial contrast zone structure at x_mm=500 the same as at x_mm=0 in state-0, i.e. are the zones axially uniform along S17?

Q7.text: What five-channel material_response does S17 return at x_mm=0, radius 90 um (outer zone) in state-0, and does it match any doc:references@1 entry given that P-A and P-B are indistinguishable there?

Q8.text: What material_response does the contacting medium U09 return at 20 C, and could the medium rather than S17 contribute to any radial contrast interval?

Q9.text: What material_response do the inner (r=2 um) and middle (r=20 um) zones of S17 return at 20 C, and do they differ from the outer zone, establishing that the outer zone is a distinct coating layer rather than the bulk?

Q10.text: Is the inner-zone response difference from the glass reference (0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052 vs 0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05) within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1, or does it indicate a distinct core material?

Q11.text: Does the small difference between the inner-zone vector [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052] and the middle-zone glass-equal vector [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] indicate a real core/interface at r about 4 um, or is it within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1?

Q12.text: Given that S17 material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0, can the axial persistence of the outer P-A/P-B-like interval be established from radial_profile at x_mm=500, or does the access contract limit which axial conclusions are possible?

Q13.text: Are the contrast zones uniform over the whole 1000 mm length of S17, or only between the two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500, given that material_response cannot be obtained away from x_mm=0?

Q14.text: What input and output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, and do any delay or secondary output events add structural information (paths, ports, internal reflections) beyond the radial zones?

Q15.text: Does raising the cell to 40 C (state-1) change the pulse_trace of S17 or of the surroundings, i.e. is any part of the observed structure or its medium temperature-dependent?

Q16.text: Does the U09 deviation from the water reference beyond 0.001 per channel indicate a water-based medium carrying an additional component, and can the doc:calibration@1 additive mixing assumption resolve the composition from the observed five-channel vector alone?

Q17.text: Can the P-A outer-coating claim of doc:model-M7@1 be transferred to S17 at all, given that S17 is immersed in the water-like medium U09 rather than the dry air named in the document's described operating example?

Q18.text: Does the constant 5.0 ns input-to-output delay of S17 change at 40 C (state-1) or after return to 20 C (state-2), i.e. is the pulse transit path temperature-dependent while the sample identity is preserved?

Q19.text: Do the pulse_trace ports S17:in and S17:out lie on the probed sample axis, and does the single output event per input exclude detectable partial reflections from the radial interfaces at r about 4 um and about 62.5 um?

Q20.text: After returning V04 to 20 C (state-2), does the pulse_trace offset of S17 return to 5.0 ns (reversible) or stay near 5.01 ns (hysteretic), and do the input/output port names remain S17:in and S17:out?

Q21.text: Given that P-A and P-B share one five-channel vector and doc:calibration@1 calls the reference library incomplete, could any accessible intervention (e.g. a temperature series of material_response, or an added reference entry) separate the outer-zone designation, or is the outer material identifiability bounded by the open reference set alone?

Q22.text: Has the new-source window added or revised catalog entries (new documents, an expanded reference set, or an updated M7 description) that could separate the outer-zone material or resolve the axial interior structure?

Q23.text: What parts, materials and conditions does doc:batch-S17@1 attribute to the S17 batch, and does it name an outer material separating P-A from P-B or describe an axial interior structure consistent with the 100/160/230 contrast zones?

history.question: Read doc:calibration@1 to obtain the instrument tolerance and stated measurement limits, so the exact match of the S17 outer-zone vector to the P-A (and P-B) reference can be judged as inside or outside tolerance for Q3.

Observe the contacting medium U09 with material_response at 20 C in state-0 to obtain its five-channel signature, so we can test whether the medium itself could contribute to the radial contrast intervals or the outer-zone reading (Q8).

Q3 requires separating P-A from P-B for S17's outer interval; the 20 C five-channel evidence cannot do that and the medium question is now answered. What time-of-flight/port structure does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, so any additional structural constraint on the outer region and its access points (and the still-open Q14) can be recorded before the evidence budget closes?

With pulse_trace for S17 in state-0 now recorded (constant 5.0 ns delay, one output per input, ports S17:in and S17:out), set the cell V04 to 40 C to enter state-1, so the temperature dependence of the pulse transit can be tested before the evidence budget closes.

Q3 still asks whether S17's outer interval is the model-M7 P-A coating; the 20 C five-channel evidence cannot separate P-A from P-B and material_response is unavailable at 40 C, so the remaining structural handle is whether the sample's transit path is invariant. What input/output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in the newly entered state-1 (40 C), so the temperature dependence of the 5.0 ns delay can be compared with state-0 and a temperature-invariant transit constraint on the sample can be added alongside the open outer-material question?

Return the cell V04 to 20 C to enter state-2, so pulse_trace can be re-measured at 20 C and the 5.0 ns / 5.01 ns difference between state-0 and state-1 can be tested for reversibility while S17 identity is preserved.

State-2 (20 C) is now the current episode and pulse_trace is available there; re-measure S17's pulse_trace to test whether the 5.0 ns to 5.01 ns transit offset seen between state-0 and state-1 reverses or persists, addressing Q18 and Q20 while identity is preserved.

For the oldest open structural question Q4, check whether the newly opened source window has revised catalog:root, since a new document or reference entry is the most direct way to resolve the still-open outer-interval material and axial-structure questions.

response.summary: Newest data: doc:batch-S17@1 (D04) names polymer P-B as S17's outer coating, while doc:model-M7@1 (D03) named P-A for the model class and its scope excludes S17; the outer-zone vector [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2] still equals both P-A and P-B references, so the designation rests on the sample-specific record, not on the instrument. access_contract.read: Только известные catalog:*, doc:* и material:*; чтение доступно во всех состояниях. Другие ссылки обозначают объекты/порты, а не читаемые документы.

access_contract.unknown_target: Сначала получить ссылку из доступного источника.
access_contract.errors: unknown_resource / capability_not_available / state_not_available — ограничения контракта. Они не являются измерениями вещества.

start.evidence_protocol: START — начальный публичный ввод; C0001 и т.д. — все попытки действий; record_id — исходная запись источника. Повтор получает новый call_id, но не новое независимое измерение. Смена состояния не создаёт новый образец.

QROOT.text: Исследуйте устройство образца S17 и его окружение. Сохраняйте найденные объекты, связи, основания и открытые вопросы. Различайте наблюдения, сообщения источников и гипотезы. Порядок, число объектов и глубина разбиения не заданы.

Q1.text: What documents, calibrations or material descriptions does catalog:root expose, and under what revision identifiers?

Q2.text: What structure does doc:model-M7@1 attribute to model M7, and does it name parts, materials or ports compatible with sample S17?

Q3.text: Does the outer surface or coating actually present on sample S17 correspond to the P-A claim made for model M7, or is the sample's outer material different?

Q4.text: What radial internal structure (interfaces, layer radii) does S17 show in state-0 at 20 C along its axis, and does any resolved outer interval correspond to the P-A coating claim for model M7 or to a different outer material?

Q5.text: Which material designations and contrast responses does doc:references@1 list, and do any of them match the contrast values of the S17 zones (100 at inner, 160 at middle, 230 at outer), in particular a P-A reference response?

Q6.text: Is the radial contrast zone structure at x_mm=500 the same as at x_mm=0 in state-0, i.e. are the zones axially uniform along S17?

Q7.text: What five-channel material_response does S17 return at x_mm=0, radius 90 um (outer zone) in state-0, and does it match any doc:references@1 entry given that P-A and P-B are indistinguishable there?

Q8.text: What material_response does the contacting medium U09 return at 20 C, and could the medium rather than S17 contribute to any radial contrast interval?

Q9.text: What material_response do the inner (r=2 um) and middle (r=20 um) zones of S17 return at 20 C, and do they differ from the outer zone, establishing that the outer zone is a distinct coating layer rather than the bulk?

Q10.text: Is the inner-zone response difference from the glass reference (0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052 vs 0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05) within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1, or does it indicate a distinct core material?

Q11.text: Does the small difference between the inner-zone vector [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052] and the middle-zone glass-equal vector [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] indicate a real core/interface at r about 4 um, or is it within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1?

Q12.text: Given that S17 material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0, can the axial persistence of the outer P-A/P-B-like interval be established from radial_profile at x_mm=500, or does the access contract limit which axial conclusions are possible?

Q13.text: Are the contrast zones uniform over the whole 1000 mm length of S17, or only between the two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500, given that material_response cannot be obtained away from x_mm=0?

Q14.text: What input and output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, and do any delay or secondary output events add structural information (paths, ports, internal reflections) beyond the radial zones?

Q15.text: Does raising the cell to 40 C (state-1) change the pulse_trace of S17 or of the surroundings, i.e. is any part of the observed structure or its medium temperature-dependent?

Q16.text: Does the U09 deviation from the water reference beyond 0.001 per channel indicate a water-based medium carrying an additional component, and can the doc:calibration@1 additive mixing assumption resolve the composition from the observed five-channel vector alone?

Q17.text: Can the P-A outer-coating claim of doc:model-M7@1 be transferred to S17 at all, given that S17 is immersed in the water-like medium U09 rather than the dry air named in the document's described operating example?

Q18.text: Does the constant 5.0 ns input-to-output delay of S17 change at 40 C (state-1) or after return to 20 C (state-2), i.e. is the pulse transit path temperature-dependent while the sample identity is preserved?

Q19.text: Do the pulse_trace ports S17:in and S17:out lie on the probed sample axis, and does the single output event per input exclude detectable partial reflections from the radial interfaces at r about 4 um and about 62.5 um?

Q20.text: After returning V04 to 20 C (state-2), does the pulse_trace offset of S17 return to 5.0 ns (reversible) or stay near 5.01 ns (hysteretic), and do the input/output port names remain S17:in and S17:out?

Q21.text: Given that P-A and P-B share one five-channel vector and doc:calibration@1 calls the reference library incomplete, could any accessible intervention (e.g. a temperature series of material_response, or an added reference entry) separate the outer-zone designation, or is the outer material identifiability bounded by the open reference set alone?

Q22.text: Has the new-source window added or revised catalog entries (new documents, an expanded reference set, or an updated M7 description) that could separate the outer-zone material or resolve the axial interior structure?

Q23.text: What parts, materials and conditions does doc:batch-S17@1 attribute to the S17 batch, and does it name an outer material separating P-A from P-B or describe an axial interior structure consistent with the 100/160/230 contrast zones?

history.question: Read doc:calibration@1 to obtain the instrument tolerance and stated measurement limits, so the exact match of the S17 outer-zone vector to the P-A (and P-B) reference can be judged as inside or outside tolerance for Q3.

Q3 requires separating P-A from P-B for S17's outer interval; the 20 C five-channel evidence cannot do that and the medium question is now answered. With pulse_trace for S17 in state-0 now recorded (constant 5.0 ns delay, one output per input, ports S17:in and S17:out), set the cell V04 to 40 C to enter state-1, so the temperature dependence of the pulse transit can be tested before the evidence budget closes.

Q3 still asks whether S17's outer interval is the model-M7 P-A coating; the 20 C five-channel evidence cannot separate P-A from P-B and material_response is unavailable at 40 C, so the remaining structural handle is whether the sample's transit path is invariant. What input/output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in the newly entered state-1 (40 C), so the temperature dependence of the 5.0 ns delay can be compared with state-0 and a temperature-invariant transit constraint on the sample can be added alongside the open outer-material question?

Return the cell V04 to 20 C to enter state-2, so pulse_trace can be re-measured at 20 C and the 5.0 ns / 5.01 ns difference between state-0 and state-1 can be tested for reversibility while S17 identity is preserved.

State-2 (20 C) is now the current episode and pulse_trace is available there; re-measure S17's pulse_trace to test whether the 5.0 ns to 5.01 ns transit offset seen between state-0 and state-1 reverses or persists, addressing Q18 and Q20 while identity is preserved.

QROOT.text: Исследуйте устройство образца S17 и его окружение. Сохраняйте найденные объекты, связи, основания и открытые вопросы. Различайте наблюдения, сообщения источников и гипотезы. Порядок, число объектов и глубина разбиения не заданы.

Q1.text: What documents, calibrations or material descriptions does catalog:root expose, and under what revision identifiers?

Q2.text: What structure does doc:model-M7@1 attribute to model M7, and does it name parts, materials or ports compatible with sample S17?

Q3.text: Does the outer surface or coating actually present on sample S17 correspond to the P-A claim made for model M7, or is the sample's outer material different?

Q4.text: What radial internal structure (interfaces, layer radii) does S17 show in state-0 at 20 C along its axis, and does any resolved outer interval correspond to the P-A coating claim for model M7 or to a different outer material?

Q5.text: Which material designations and contrast responses does doc:references@1 list, and do any of them match the contrast values of the S17 zones (100 at inner, 160 at middle, 230 at outer), in particular a P-A reference response?

Q6.text: Is the radial contrast zone structure at x_mm=500 the same as at x_mm=0 in state-0, i.e. are the zones axially uniform along S17?

Q7.text: What five-channel material_response does S17 return at x_mm=0, radius 90 um (outer zone) in state-0, and does it match any doc:references@1 entry given that P-A and P-B are indistinguishable there?

Q8.text: What material_response does the contacting medium U09 return at 20 C, and could the medium rather than S17 contribute to any radial contrast interval?

Q9.text: What material_response do the inner (r=2 um) and middle (r=20 um) zones of S17 return at 20 C, and do they differ from the outer zone, establishing that the outer zone is a distinct coating layer rather than the bulk?

Q10.text: Is the inner-zone response difference from the glass reference (0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052 vs 0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05) within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1, or does it indicate a distinct core material?

Q11.text: Does the small difference between the inner-zone vector [0.88,0.224,0.108,0.06,0.052] and the middle-zone glass-equal vector [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] indicate a real core/interface at r about 4 um, or is it within the tolerance stated in doc:calibration@1?

Q12.text: Given that S17 material_response is tabulated only at x_mm=0, can the axial persistence of the outer P-A/P-B-like interval be established from radial_profile at x_mm=500, or does the access contract limit which axial conclusions are possible?

Q13.text: Are the contrast zones uniform over the whole 1000 mm length of S17, or only between the two probed sections x_mm=0 and x_mm=500, given that material_response cannot be obtained away from x_mm=0?

Q14.text: What input and output times does pulse_trace report for S17 in state-0, and do any delay or secondary output events add structural information (paths, ports, internal reflections) beyond the radial zones?

Q15.text: Does raising the cell to 40 C (state-1) change the pulse_trace of S17 or of the surroundings, i.e. is any part of the observed structure or its medium temperature-dependent?

Q16.text: Does the U09 deviation from the water reference beyond 0.001 per channel indicate a water-based medium carrying an additional component, and can the doc:calibration@1 additive mixing assumption resolve the composition from the observed five-channel vector alone?

Q17.text: Can the P-A outer-coating claim of doc:model-M7@1 be transferred to S17 at all, given that S17 is immersed in the water-like medium U09 rather than the dry air named in the document's described operating example?

Q18.text: Does the constant 5.0 ns input-to-output delay of S17 change at 40 C (state-1) or after return to 20 C (state-2), i.e. is the pulse transit path temperature-dependent while the sample identity is preserved?

Q19.text: Do the pulse_trace ports S17:in and S17:out lie on the probed sample axis, and does the single output event per input exclude detectable partial reflections from the radial interfaces at r about 4 um and about 62.5 um?

Q20.text: After returning V04 to 20 C (state-2), does the pulse_trace offset of S17 return to 5.0 ns (reversible) or stay near 5.01 ns (hysteretic), and do the input/output port names remain S17:in and S17:out?

Q21.text: Given that P-A and P-B share one five-channel vector and doc:calibration@1 calls the reference library incomplete, could any accessible intervention (e.g. a temperature series of material_response, or an added reference entry) separate the outer-zone designation, or is the outer material identifiability bounded by the open reference set alone?

Q22.text: Has the new-source window added or revised catalog entries (new documents, an expanded reference set, or an updated M7 description) that could separate the outer-zone material or resolve the axial interior structure?

Q23.text: What parts, materials and conditions does doc:batch-S17@1 attribute to the S17 batch, and does it name an outer material separating P-A from P-B or describe an axial interior structure consistent with the 100/160/230 contrast zones?

Return the cell V04 to 20 C to enter state-2, so pulse_trace can be re-measured at 20 C and the 5.0 ns / 5.01 ns difference between state-0 and state-1 can be tested for reversibility while S17 identity is preserved.

State-2 (20 C) is now the current episode and pulse_trace is available there; re-measure S17's pulse_trace to test whether the 5.0 ns to 5.01 ns transit offset seen between state-0 and state-1 reverses or persists, addressing Q18 and Q20 while identity is preserved.
